title: Insight
description: One explainability result for a selected input at a step of a run, such as gradient times input saliency (epic:training-observatory). Its values match a finite-difference check within 1e-2 (epic acceptance).

step.description: The step whose parameters the insight was computed with (DESIGN.md § 6.1 step number).

input_name.description: The name of the input binding the insight attributes to, a DataSpec.name of the run's artifact with role Input (DESIGN.md § 2).

shape.description: The shape of the attribution, the selected input's.

values.description: The attribution per element of the selected input, in row-major order (DESIGN.md § 2.3); as many as the elements of shape, which ESS does not state here.

modelspec.checkpoint.Shape.title: Shape
modelspec.checkpoint.Shape.description: A tensor shape; each dimension is a positive integer and rank 0 is a scalar (DESIGN.md § 2.2).

modelspec.observatory.InsightMethod.title: InsightMethod
modelspec.observatory.InsightMethod.description: The explainability method an insight was computed with; gradient times input saliency first, since the compiler already derives gradients (epic:training-observatory).
